consumer: A dialogue/condition possession check (set_has_item building the u_has_item/npc_has_item lambda) that EVALUATES a yes/no: does this character personally carry the detonator?
scope: only the character's own carried items (wielded + worn + personal inventory), NOT nearby/reachable items
decisive_source: src/condition.cpp::conditional_t<T>::set_has_item — body returns actor->charges_of(item_id)>0 || actor->has_amount(item_id,1) over the character actor, i.e. an engine-computed boolean scoped to on-person possession
divergence: Detonator sits in a crate one tile away (or on an adjacent NPC) with nothing on the player's body: the correct on-person predicate returns false, but a wrong authority using crafting_inventory() (MGOAL_FIND_ITEM reach) returns true.
